title: Callout
summary: An inline message that stays on the page, next to the thing it is about. Use it for preparation instructions, verification results and errors the person must act on.

demos.title: Tones
demos.note: Four tones, each with its own icon, so the meaning never rests on colour alone. Info is the default.

demos.title: In response to an action
demos.note: When a callout appears because of something the person did, give it role="alert" so screen readers announce it. Press Verify, then add a digit and press it again.
